title: ENCORE: Entropy-guided Reward Composition for Multi-head Safety Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where specific heads are prompted to penalize stereotyping and insults based on race or ethnicity.
Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where specific heads are prompted to penalize stereotyping and insults based on gender.
Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where a specific head is prompted to penalize stereotyping based on sexual orientation.
Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where a specific head is prompted to penalize hate speech and insults based on religion.
Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where a specific head is prompted to penalize cultural appropriation and evaluate respect for cultural identities and contexts.
Evaluating LLM responses using a multi-head reward model where a specific head is prompted to evaluate whether the response facilitates intergenerational understanding and respects across ages.
